name: Albany International Airport (ALB)
title: ALB - Albany International Airport Taxi Service
detailHtml:
Travelers arriving at Albany International Airport are served by Albany Airport Taxi and Limo Service. The dispatcher can be reached at +1-518-327-0700

Travelers may also contact the taxi company of their choice. Lyft and Uber service along with bus services provided by the Capital District Transit Authority (CDTA), Trailways and Vermont Translines are also available.
 
Albany Airport Taxi and Limo drivers may drop off passengers in front of the terminal and pick up passengers at the curb outside of baggage claim.
